name: Texas Triangle
blurb: Austin → San Antonio → Houston → Dallas → back to Austin, by road.

checkpoints.name: Austin, TX
checkpoints.fact: The Texas Capitol is taller than the U.S. Capitol in Washington, D.C.

checkpoints.name: San Marcos, TX
checkpoints.fact: Spring Lake here is fed by the San Marcos Springs, home to species found nowhere else on Earth.

checkpoints.name: New Braunfels, TX
checkpoints.fact: German settlers founded New Braunfels in 1845.

checkpoints.name: San Antonio, TX
checkpoints.fact: Remember the Alamo! It stands a few blocks from the River Walk.

checkpoints.name: Seguin, TX
checkpoints.fact: Seguin's courthouse lawn has a giant pecan statue, billed as the world's largest.

checkpoints.name: Columbus, TX
checkpoints.fact: Columbus sits on the Colorado River: the Texas one, not the Grand Canyon one.

checkpoints.name: Houston, TX
checkpoints.fact: Mission Control at Johnson Space Center guided the Apollo Moon landings.

checkpoints.name: Huntsville, TX
checkpoints.fact: A 67-foot statue of Sam Houston watches over I-45 here.

checkpoints.name: Corsicana, TX
checkpoints.fact: Collin Street Bakery has shipped fruitcakes around the world from Corsicana since 1896.

checkpoints.name: Dallas, TX
checkpoints.fact: The frozen margarita machine was invented in Dallas in 1971.

checkpoints.name: Waco, TX
checkpoints.fact: Dr Pepper was created at a Waco drugstore in 1885.

checkpoints.name: Back in Austin!
checkpoints.fact: Celebrate under the Congress Avenue Bridge, home to North America's largest urban bat colony.

name: Appalachian Trail
blurb: Springer Mountain, Georgia → Mount Katahdin, Maine, through 14 states.

checkpoints.name: Springer Mountain, GA
checkpoints.fact: The southern end of the trail. Look for the first white blaze painted on the rock.

checkpoints.name: Neels Gap, GA
checkpoints.fact: The trail passes right through a building here: the stone Walasi-Yi Center, built in the 1930s.

checkpoints.name: Fontana Dam, NC
checkpoints.fact: At 480 feet, Fontana is the tallest dam east of the Rocky Mountains.

checkpoints.name: Clingmans Dome, TN
checkpoints.fact: The highest point on the whole trail: 6,643 feet.

checkpoints.name: Hot Springs, NC
checkpoints.fact: The trail runs right down Main Street, past natural hot springs.

checkpoints.name: Damascus, VA
checkpoints.fact: "Trail Town USA" throws a hiker festival, Trail Days, every May.

checkpoints.name: McAfee Knob, VA
checkpoints.fact: This rock ledge is said to be the most photographed spot on the trail.

checkpoints.name: Harpers Ferry, WV
checkpoints.fact: The "psychological halfway point," home of the Appalachian Trail Conservancy.

checkpoints.name: Pine Grove Furnace, PA
checkpoints.fact: Past the halfway mark, hikers try the Half Gallon Challenge: half a gallon of ice cream in one sitting.

checkpoints.name: Delaware Water Gap
checkpoints.fact: The trail crosses the Delaware River from Pennsylvania into New Jersey.

checkpoints.name: Bear Mountain, NY
checkpoints.fact: The very first section of the trail opened here in 1923.

checkpoints.name: Mount Greylock, MA
checkpoints.fact: The highest point in Massachusetts: 3,491 feet.

checkpoints.name: Hanover, NH
checkpoints.fact: The trail walks straight through Dartmouth College's hometown.

checkpoints.name: Mount Washington, NH
checkpoints.fact: A 231 mph gust was recorded on the summit in 1934.

checkpoints.name: Mahoosuc Notch, ME
checkpoints.fact: A boulder scramble often called the hardest (or most fun) mile of the trail.

checkpoints.name: Monson, ME
checkpoints.fact: The last town before the 100-Mile Wilderness.

checkpoints.name: Mount Katahdin, ME
checkpoints.fact: The northern end of the trail: Baxter Peak, 5,267 feet. You did it!
